main.description: Keyed `<repo key>.<ref hash>`, where the hash is the first 26 characters of the lowercase unpadded base32 SHA-256 of `name`. Written only in the same applyWrites as the dev.knotless.claim for its current generation.

createdAt.description: When the ref was made: the same as updatedAt until it first moves.

generation.description: Goes up by one each time the ref moves. A new ref starts at the time in milliseconds since the epoch, past any generation an earlier ref of the same name reached; records written before 0.6 started at 1.

name.description: The full ref name, such as refs/heads/main.

pack.description: The record key of the dev.knotless.pack holding `target`, as the move that set it knew: the pack that move wrote, or the one another ref at the same commit named. A fetch reads it rather than walking the packs. A compaction folds packs into a new one without moving refs, so a reader finding it gone walks the packs instead.

pusher.description: The account that last moved the ref, when not the repository's owner: a collaborator or runner pushing through the gateway, which sets it from the caller's verified service token. Readers credit it only while the repository names it among its collaborators or runners.

repo.description: The `key` of the dev.knotless.repo this ref belongs to.

target.description: The hex object ID the ref points at. Absent only from a record a client before 0.6 left of a deleted ref; a delete now deletes the record.

description: One git ref of a repository.
